**Builds are not code-signed.** macOS builds are ad-hoc signed and not notarized;
Windows builds carry no Authenticode signature. Both operating systems will warn on
first launch — see the
[README's Install section](https://github.com/evolvconsulting/claude-conduit#install)
for the exact click-through steps and what to expect.

`SHA256SUMS` below covers every artifact and update-metadata file in this release.
